The South Sudan Country Office seeks a consultant to support the preparation and quality assurance of its 2026 Country Office Annual Reporting package. Under the overall guidance of the Chief, Planning, Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting (PMER), the consultant will substantively edit and quality assure the RAM Outcome and Output results figures and narrative reports and consolidate, draft and copy-edit the Country Office End-Year Summary Narrative Report. The assignment will ensure that both products clearly articulate results, draw on consistent and verifiable information, and comply with the applicable 2026 UNICEF reporting guidance and UNICEF Style Guide.
